title: rhododendron subulatum
intro: Rhododendron subulatum, commonly known as the Alpine Azalea, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, where it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rhododendron subulatum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess immunomodulatory, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities.
